QuestInfo.name: The Mushmom Who Woke
QuestInfo.1: #b#p603##k says the old Mushmom buried in #m10005078# has risen again as a #r#o700002##k. Every mushroom near her goes bad, so he can't gather them for medicine. I need to defeat the #r#o700002##k.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the #o700002#. Now she can rest again, and #b#p603##k can gather his mushrooms.

0.0: Ah, traveler! I need your help. This time, it's about mushrooms.
0.1: Deep in the Ant Tunnel there is a place called #m10005078#. A giant Mushmom was laid to rest there long ago.
0.2: But something woke her up. Now she walks as a #r#o700002##k, and every mushroom near her goes bad. Please defeat the #r#o700002##k for me.

yes.0: Thank you! Go deep into the Ant Tunnel and find #m10005078#. She is very strong, so bring friends!

no.0: I see. Come back if you change your mind.

1.0: You defeated her? Wonderful! Now she can finally rest again.
1.1: Here, a reward for your courage. Now, back to my herbs!

mob.0: The #o700002# is still walking around. Please defeat her.
